## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d1fda66e1a89350fb837204d3af833e328921006`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Diff: one file, `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` (+19/−14, whole file 364 → 369), byte-identical to the net diff against `main` at the merge-base `733fd5ac65` (`main` has not moved that file since). No accept set moves: `packages/**`, `apps/**` and `.changeset/**` are untouched. The changed surface is a published agent-facing guide (`npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectui` reads this tree), so the judgments below ask whether its new text is true on this tree and whether the fence passes.

Prose claim 1 — "Expression roots are the keys of the `scope` a host publishes through `PredicateScopeProvider`": RIGHT for the fence's setup. `configEvaluationScope` in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` spreads `usePredicateScope()` and adds only `current_user` (aliased from `scope.user`), `record` (only under a RecordContext) and `page`; `PredicateScopeProvider` (`packages/react/src/hooks/useExpression.ts`) publishes its `scope` prop verbatim as the context value. The fuller root table lives in the guide the prose links.

Prose claim 2 — "`SchemaRendererProvider`'s `dataSource` is the CRUD adapter and publishes none": RIGHT. `SchemaRendererContext` types it `DataSource | null | undefined`; `configEvaluationScope` binds no `data` root from it (the retired `data: dataSource` binding is recorded in the comment block above the evaluation memo), and the only `data` reads left in that file are `predicateScope.data` — a scope key like any other.

Prose claim 3 — "a `hidden` gate on a name nothing published fails soft to `true`, hiding the node for every user": RIGHT, and the mechanism is the template path, not the bare-string catch. `evaluateCondition` routes a `${…}` string to `evaluate`, whose single-template branch calls `evaluateExpression`, which throws `userRole is not defined`; the outer catch returns `defaultValue ?? expression`, i.e. the source string, `Boolean` of a non-empty string is `true`, `_hidden` is set and `SchemaRenderer` returns `null`. Same verdict the card measured on the built evaluator.

Fence — imports: `PredicateScopeProvider` and `SchemaRenderer` are both exported by `@object-ui/react` (index → `hooks/index.js` → `useExpression.js`; `SchemaRenderer.js`). RIGHT.
Fence — the admin leg: `userRole: 'admin'` in scope makes `userRole !== "admin"` false, the node is shown and `getByText('Secret')` resolves; the comment `// admin should see it` is kept, not inverted, as the card demanded. RIGHT.
Fence — the viewer leg via `rerender`: the evaluation memo's dependency list names `predicateScope` (`[schema, dataSource, predicateScope, pageVariables, boundRecord]`), so a new scope object re-evaluates; `'viewer' !== "admin"` is true, the node is hidden, `queryByText('Secret')` is `null`. RIGHT. Dropping the `SchemaRendererProvider` element is safe: `SchemaRenderer` reads that context optionally (`context?.dataSource || NO_DATA_SOURCE`).
Fence — `type: 'text'` with `content`: the winning registration is `ElementTextRenderer` (`renderers/basic/elements.tsx`, registered after `text.tsx`; `Registry.register` overwrites on `Map.set`), which renders `pickLocalized(props.content, language)`, and `pickLocalized` returns a string as-is. RIGHT.

Does an agent copying the fence get a passing test? With the `text` renderer registered — YES, both tests; the dev measured red → green on the current renderer (RED: `userRole is not defined`, empty body; GREEN: 2 passed), and every step of that measurement checks out against the source above. Copied with ONLY the fence's own imports — NO: `text` is registered by `@object-ui/components` (its index side-effect-imports `./renderers`), which the fence never imports, so `SchemaRenderer` paints its `Unknown component type: text` alert in BOTH tests, before and after this diff alike. That gap is pre-existing, outside card #9380 (whose defect is the root) and outside the dispatched file surface; the guide's own "Common testing mistakes" first bullet names the class, imprecisely ("Not importing plugin packages in test setup" — `@object-ui/components` is not a plugin). Escalated in ③; not a defect of this diff.

Citations: the new prose and the PR body cite by symbol and quoted string, no line addresses; `Line Citation Gate` is green (0 new). The relative link `./auth-permissions.md` resolves (`Skill Guide Path Check` and `Internal Docs Link Check` green), and that guide's "Schema-level visibility with expressions" section says exactly what the prose attributes to it, including the fail-soft table.

Gate verdicts — the check-runs on this head, read at 2026-09-28T09:14Z: 39 check-runs, 36 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`dependabot` and the two coverage legs — path-filter skips), 0 failure, 0 in progress. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Skill Example Check` (the gate the dev could not run locally), `Skill Eval Token Check`, `Skill Guide Path Check`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Test` and all eight test shards are `success`. Every check is green.

### ② Semver level

None — nothing publishes. `skills/**` sits in no workspace package's `files[]` (measured over every `packages/*/package.json` and `apps/*/package.json` at this head), so no npm tarball carries the changed file; the skill ships to agents through `npx skills add`, which reads this tree and has no version or changeset surface. No changeset and no `skip-changeset` label is the correct declaration, and the three changeset checks agree. `Clause-②: no` is RIGHT: the diff moves no accept set and no public contract surface; it corrects a guide to the scope channel the renderer already publishes.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (six) — each answered:
1. PM-suggested `data.userRole` route not taken — RIGHT to refuse: `configEvaluationScope` binds no `data`, and `schema-expressions.md` on this tree warns that re-publishing `data` only restores an always-false verdict. The card's first route (`PredicateScopeProvider`) is the one taken; the expression text is unchanged.
2. Viewer leg added beyond the minimal text — accepted: it makes the test named "hides component when hidden expression is true" exercise its hidden branch; the admin assertion is unchanged; +5 of the +6 budget used (364 → 369; `SKILL.md` 137, unchanged).
3. `check:skill-examples` declared to CI — closed: `Skill Example Check` is `success` on this head.
4. objectstack's `dispatch-gates.mjs` not used — RIGHT: objectui's `scripts/` has no such file at this head; the gate set was derived from the repo's own workflows, and all of them ran.
5. PR body spells the reporter's angle-bracket separator as `›` — cosmetic, correct under the body-sanitizer rule.
6. Model-free commit trailer pair — verified on the head commit (`Claude-Session:` URL plus `Co-authored-by: Claude`).

`open_questions`: none declared; none found.

Out-of-scope findings — answered or escalated:
- (dev, "carrier: none · noted, not filed") The fence copied with only its own imports fails on `Unknown component type: text`. ESCALATED to the adopting session: a reproducible copy-and-fails defect in a published guide is card-worthy (Prime Directive #10 class), and the existing "Common testing mistakes" bullet does not name `@object-ui/components` as the package that registers the base renderers — it owes a card (or a one-line `import '@object-ui/components';` in this fence under a fresh review). Not blocking this diff: pre-existing on both sides, and the card's own defect is fully closed.
- (dev, "carrier: this PR") The old fence's plain bag in the `DataSource` slot (TS2740 for a `tsc` reader) leaves with this diff — agreed, no action.
- (dev, observation) `i18n.md`'s "Language-aware + responsive page" fence hands an undeclared identifier named `data` to `dataSource` — agreed it is naming only (nothing gates on it; a fragment); repair opportunistically when that file is next touched, no card.
- (reviewer, new) `skills/objectui/evals/testing.json` eval 1 still expects a "rendering test with SchemaRendererProvider and mock dataSource, and expression-based visibility test" and requires the token `SchemaRendererProvider` — the wiring this card retired for a visibility gate. `Skill Eval Token Check` is green only because `SKILL.md` still teaches that token for its real job (adapter injection). ESCALATED: the eval's expected output should name `PredicateScopeProvider` for the visibility leg; it is outside the dispatched file surface (fence and prose only), so a follow-up card, not this PR.

Governed-surface note: `skills/**` is Tier H in both registers (`skills-catalog`). This record is the contract-tier review the claim promised; landing still needs an authorized APPROVED review from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` and is then the owning seat's act — no AI seat readies, queues or arms this PR on this record.

Fence — the viewer leg via `rerender`: the evaluation memo's dependency list names `predicateScope`, so a new scope object re-evaluates; `'viewer' !== "admin"` is true, the node is hidden and `queryByText('Secret')` is `null`. RIGHT.
Fence — types, for a reader who runs `tsc`: `SchemaRendererProps.schema` is `BaseSchema | string | null | undefined`; `BaseSchema` declares `hidden?: boolean | ExpressionWire` (a string is one) and an open `[key: string]: any`, so the flat `content` and the string `hidden` type-check without `as const`; `PredicateScopeProvider`'s `scope` is a `Record` of `string` to `any`, which the bag satisfies. RIGHT — and the old fence's plain bag in the `DataSource` slot (TS2740) leaves with the diff.

Does an agent copying the fence VERBATIM get two passing tests? YES on this tree. The fence now carries every import it needs: `vitest`, `@testing-library/react`, the two `@object-ui/react` names and the `@object-ui/components` side effect that registers `ui:text`. The dev's control is the right shape — same file minus the one import fails both tests with `Unknown component type:`, the published fence passes both — and it was run in the `dom` project whose light setup (`vitest.setup.dom-light.tsx`: base setup, jest-dom matchers, locale catalogues, `cleanup`, a `scrollIntoView` stub) registers no renderer, so nothing in that setup did the fence's work for it. Module top of `@object-ui/components` asks for none of the setup's polyfills: no zero-indent `window`, `document` or `ResizeObserver` use exists under `packages/components/src`. What a reader supplies is what the guide already names — a DOM environment (`happy-dom`, per "Common testing mistakes") and one installed copy of `@object-ui/core`, so both packages share the registry singleton, the ordinary install shape.

## 维护者速读(终稿)

席位 `domain:devx` @ objectui 第 2 席(`session_01EBx9rvB7dufCz4at53x35U`)对照本 PR 的实际 diff(head `fd764036b1`)校正 dev 草稿后定稿;契约复审档复核 PASS 在案(`5867268801`),席位复核记录在 objectui#9380。

**改了什么**:只改对外发布的技能指南 `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` 里「Pattern 5」一个示例(净增 6 行,正好用满预算)。原示例把 `userRole` 塞进数据源,再用 `${userRole !== "admin"}` 控制隐藏——渲染器从不把数据源的键发布成表达式变量,于是表达式出错、按「失败即隐藏」处理,管理员也看不到节点,照抄的测试必然失败。现在改为通过 `PredicateScopeProvider` 发布 `userRole`(与兄弟指南教的写法一致),补一行 `import '@object-ui/components';` 注册渲染器,并加一条「普通用户看不到」的断言,让「隐藏」分支真的被测到。示例上方两行说明点破了这个坑。

**为什么改**:技能包是 AI 照着写代码的材料,一个照抄即失败的示例等于产品缺陷。dev 在当前渲染器上实测:原示例照抄两个测试都失败,新示例照抄两个都通过;去掉注册那一行则失败(对照)。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改一段示例文本,不碰任何包代码、不发版(`skills/**` 通过 `npx skills add` 分发)。PR 正文里写的「+5 / 369 行」是第一轮的旧数,实际是 +6 / 370。回滚:revert 本 PR。

**席位意见**:建议批准。席位核对了 `PredicateScopeProvider` 确从 `@object-ui/react` 入口导出;两轮达档契约复审均 PASS,第二轮专门确认了「原样照抄即通过」。两处相邻小问题(`evals/testing.json` 第 1 条仍以旧写法为期望、「常见错误」第一条只说 plugin 包)未改,记为 Acceptance notes,留给下一个碰这份指南的 PR。

**你要做的**:在本 PR 上点 Approve(`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 任一账号即可);之后翻 ready、入队由席位完成。
